name: hand-written: flow rules
yaml:
default: allow
ttlMs: 30000
rules:
  - { tool: Bash, command: "^\\s*rm\\s+-[rRf]+\\s+/(\\s|$)", action: deny, reason: "rm -rf / blocked" }
  - { tool: [Read, Write], action: allow }
  # a comment
  - tool: Bash
    command: '(^|\s)curl(?!.*--max-time)'
    action: rewrite
    rewriteFrom: '(^|\s)curl\b'
    rewriteTo: "$1curl --max-time 10"

name: hand-written: block scalars and anchors
yaml:
name: reviewer
description: >
  Reviews a change
  and reports back.
prompt: |
  Line one
    indented
  Line three
base: &base
  model: sonnet
  effort: high
other:
  <<: *base
  effort: low
tools:
  allow: [Read, Grep, "mcp__*"]
  editRegex: ^src/(?!generated/).*\.(ts|tsx)$
